{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "own": "<id from her_items or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description", ""her_items" — her own items; an item of the description that is one of them gets its id in "own""]}, "description": "Dark grey pencil skirt, straight cut, knee length, #2F3335, wool blend.
Tan leather ankle boots, rounded toe, mid-calf height, #C19A6B, smooth leather.
Cream silk-blend blouse, relaxed fit, long sleeves, #F5F0E6, lightweight woven fabric.

This outfit honors your request to include your skirt while adapting it for the office environment with a professional yet comfortable feel. The neutral tones of the dark grey skirt and cream blouse create a sophisticated palette perfect for autumn weather in the city. By choosing structured ankle boots over casual sneakers, this ensemble elevates the look from everyday wear to neat business attire without feeling stiff or restrictive.", "her_items": [{"id": "її-с1", "name": "моєї спідниці"}]}
